status: development; linear baseline before nonlinear sensitivity
initial_interpretation: The structural fingerprint is moderately low-dimensional but not one- or two-dimensional. PC1 is heavily aligned with section/Currier/hand and physical order, while PC2-PC3 contain substantial variation weakly associated with those labels. Three dimensions explain about 68% and five about 83% of variance. H56-1 is provisionally compatible with a compact multi-axis state, but nonlinear sensitivity and transfer tests remain required.
